description: Structured eval definitions for the Step Functions Express Workflows Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING across Distributed Map with logging, Standard-to-Express migration with .waitForTaskToken, sync API Gateway timeout alignment, missing-logging on async, and at-least-once idempotency. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Express with Distributed Map, CloudWatch Logs ALL, EventBridge schedule, idempotency
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Distributed Map + ALL-level logging + includeExecutionData + EventBridge + alarm
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Express Workflow named "order-processor" in account 123456789012, region us-east-1. The workflow uses a Distributed Map with an S3 ItemReader (bucket "my-bucket", key "input.json") and Lambda Task "process-item" per item, MaxConcurrency 1000. Attach a CloudWatch Logs log group /aws/states/order-processor at level ALL with includeExecutionData=true and 30-day retention. The Lambda handler is idempotent via IdempotencyKey from $$.Execution.Id. Execution role scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on the process-item ARN and s3:GetObject on the input object. Configure EventBridge to invoke the workflow every 5 minutes with the EventBridge target role. Add an alarm on ExecutionsFailed.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPRESS_WORKFLOW: order-processor
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Express-vs-Standard decision: EXPRESS (Distributed Map, high-volume, idempotent)
  [✓] Duration budget: per-item < 1s, MaxConcurrency 1000 fits in 5-min cap
  [✓] No .waitForTaskToken in ASL: verified (grep returned 0 matches)
  [✓] ASL definition validated: Distributed Map + Lambda Task + S3 ItemReader
  [✓] IAM execution role: scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on process-item + s3:GetObject on input
  [✓] Logging: /aws/states/order-processor, level ALL, includeExecutionData=true, retention 30d
  [✓] Invocation mode: async (EventBridge rate(5 minutes))
  [✓] EventBridge schedule + CloudWatch alarm: rate(5 minutes) + alarm on ExecutionsFailed
  [✓] Idempotency: Lambda uses IdempotencyKey.$: $$.Execution.Id
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws stepfunctions describe-state-machine --state-machine-arn arn:aws:states:us-east-1:123456789012:stateMachine:order-processor
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/states/order-processor
  aws events describe-rule --name order-processor-schedule
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names order-processor-failed

eval_cases.name: Standard-to-Express migration blocked by .waitForTaskToken and 5-min cap
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — .waitForTaskToken + 6-min runtime both incompatible with Express
eval_cases.prompt: Migrate this Standard state machine to EXPRESS for cost savings. The state machine "approval-flow" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1) uses an SQS sendMessage.waitForTaskToken integration at line 18 to wait for an external approval callback. The workflow also has a 4-minute Glue .sync job plus a 2-minute downstream ECS task. Total workflow runtime is up to 6 minutes when the callback is slow. Set up CloudWatch Logs at ERROR level.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPRESS_WORKFLOW: approval-flow
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Express-vs-Standard decision: EXPRESS requested
  [✗] Duration budget: 4-min Glue + 2-min ECS = 6 min; cannot fit in 5-min Express cap — migrate to STANDARD or split into Standard (callback) + Express (hot path)
  [✗] No .waitForTaskToken in ASL: FAILED — arn:aws:states:::sqs:sendMessage.waitForTaskToken at line 18; replace with .sync or STANDARD
  [✗] ASL definition validated: blocked pending integration fixes
  [✓] IAM execution role: scoped
  [✗] Logging: blocked pending ASL fix
  [OPTIONAL] Invocation mode: not applicable pending ASL fix
  [OPTIONAL] EventBridge schedule: not requested
  [✗] Idempotency: cannot verify pending ASL fix
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  grep -E ':waitForTaskToken' approval-flow.json
  aws logs create-log-group --log-group-name /aws/states/approval-flow

eval_cases.name: Sync Express fronted by API Gateway with timeout aligned to 29000ms and ExecutionsTimedOut alarm
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — sync mode + API Gateway integration timeout 29000ms + alarm on ExecutionsTimedOut
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Express workflow "checkout-api" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1) invoked synchronously from API Gateway. Workflow p99 is 8 seconds. Attach CloudWatch Logs at ALL level with includeExecutionData=true. The execution role is scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on function:checkout-handler. Make sure the API Gateway integration timeout is set correctly so the client does not receive a 504 while the workflow is still running. Add an alarm on ExecutionsTimedOut.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPRESS_WORKFLOW: checkout-api
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Express-vs-Standard decision: EXPRESS (sync, p99 8s < 29s)
  [✓] Duration budget: p99 8s; API Gateway integration timeout 29000ms
  [✓] No .waitForTaskToken in ASL: verified
  [✓] ASL definition validated
  [✓] IAM execution role: scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on checkout-handler
  [✓] Logging: /aws/states/checkout-api, level ALL, includeExecutionData=true
  [✓] Invocation mode: sync (start-sync-execution); API Gateway integration timeout 29000ms
  [OPTIONAL] EventBridge schedule: not requested
  [✓] Alarm on ExecutionsTimedOut configured
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws stepfunctions describe-state-machine --state-machine-arn arn:aws:states:us-east-1:123456789012:stateMachine:checkout-api
  aws apigateway get-method --rest-api-id <API_ID> --resource-id <RES_ID> --http-method POST
  aws cloudwatch describe-alarms --alarm-names checkout-api-timed-out

eval_cases.name: Async Express with no log group attached — must flag as PREREQUISITES_MISSING
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — async Express without CloudWatch Logs is a NEVER pattern
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an async Express Workflow "batch-loader" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1) triggered by EventBridge rate(1 minute). I will attach CloudWatch Logs later — skip the loggingConfiguration for now. The execution role is scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on function:loader. Add the EventBridge target role. Make sure I can debug failures.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPRESS_WORKFLOW: batch-loader
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Express-vs-Standard decision: EXPRESS (async, high-frequency)
  [✓] Duration budget: fits
  [✓] No .waitForTaskToken in ASL: verified
  [✓] ASL definition validated
  [✓] IAM execution role: scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on loader
  [✗] Logging: no log group attached — async Express without logging is a NEVER pattern; create /aws/states/batch-loader first
  [✓] Invocation mode: async (EventBridge rate(1 minute))
  [✓] EventBridge schedule + target role: configured
  [✗] Alarm on ExecutionsFailed: cannot verify without logging
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws logs create-log-group --log-group-name /aws/states/batch-loader
  aws logs put-retention-policy --log-group-name /aws/states/batch-loader --retention-in-days 30

eval_cases.name: Express workflow with side-effecting Lambda and idempotency via $$.Execution.Id
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — DynamoDB idempotency record + Lambda charge-card with IdempotencyKey
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Express workflow "charge-card-flow" (account 123456789012, region us-east-1). The workflow calls Lambda function "charge-card" which charges a credit card — this MUST be idempotent because Express is at-least-once. Use $$.Execution.Id as the idempotency key, persisted in DynamoDB table "IdempotencyTable" BEFORE the charge. Attach CloudWatch Logs at ALL level. Execution role scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction and dynamodb:PutItem/GetItem on the table. Workflow runs async via start-execution.
eval_cases.expected_output:
EXPRESS_WORKFLOW: charge-card-flow
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Express-vs-Standard decision: EXPRESS (idempotent side effect via key)
  [✓] Duration budget: charge-card p99 1s < 5 min
  [✓] No .waitForTaskToken in ASL: verified
  [✓] ASL definition validated: DynamoDB PutItem (idempotency record) → Lambda charge-card with IdempotencyKey
  [✓] IAM execution role: scoped to lambda:InvokeFunction on charge-card + dynamodb on IdempotencyTable
  [✓] Logging: /aws/states/charge-card-flow, level ALL, includeExecutionData=true
  [✓] Invocation mode: async (start-execution)
  [OPTIONAL] EventBridge schedule: not requested
  [✓] Idempotency: IdempotencyKey.$: $$.Execution.Id persisted in IdempotencyTable BEFORE ChargeCard
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws stepfunctions describe-state-machine --state-machine-arn arn:aws:states:us-east-1:123456789012:stateMachine:charge-card-flow
  aws logs describe-log-groups --log-group-name-prefix /aws/states/charge-card-flow
